capabilities: Create and refresh ServiceNow ticket notes with work notes, work logs, and status
Track to-dos on a configurable four-state board and a ticket dashboard
Import meeting minutes from Markdown or Google Drive and link them to tickets
Optionally connect Jira and Confluence to read comments, import schedules, and post comments
Maintain an optional AI Wiki of work records with a guided AI connection workflow
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian Desktop 1.11.5+, no mobile support). ServiceNow, Google Drive, Jira/Confluence, translation, and AI Wiki features are all optional; local note and To-Do features work without connections. Tokens and OAuth JSON are stored in Obsidian Secret Storage. Organization-specific status guides and AI templates come from a separately supplied JSON work guide pack, not the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to connect notes to a ServiceNow instance, sync ticket metadata and work notes, or track ticket-related tasks.

relations.evidence: Refresh ticket metadata and work notes from ServiceNow.
optional Atlassian connection and Jira workspace
Connect Jira and Confluence optionally, automatically refresh linked Jira work with ServiceNow tickets
Import Gemini meeting minutes from Markdown, optionally preserve the source PDF
uses a compatible Obsidian translation plugin/provider configured by the user

summary: ServiceNow integration that manages ticket notes, work notes, status refreshes, To-Do boards, and dashboards, with optional Jira, Confluence, and Google Drive connections.
